mapper.select: SELECT ys.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(ys.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , TO_CHAR(ys.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , ys.TR_CD , ys.FUND_CD , ys.TR_CO_CD , ys.TRUSTEE , ys.JM_CD , ys.CURRENCY , ys.TR_SEQ , TO_CHAR(ys.GYULJE_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gyulje_ymd , ys.GYULJE_AEK , ys.WON_GYULJE_AEK , ys.GYULJE_GB , ys.GYULJE_JM_CD , ya.JM_NM AS sym0ya_jm_nm , ya.JASAN_GB , ys.WON_HWAN_CHA , ys.SURY_AEK , ys.BS_TYPE , ia.FUND_NM , ia.FUND_CURRENCY , ys.FCUR_GYULJE_AEK , ys.FCUR_HWAN_CHA AS syt0ys_fcur_hwan_cha , ys.BUNHAL_AEK FROM SYT0YS ys LEFT OUTER JOIN SYM0YA ya ON ya.CORP_GR = ys.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = ys.JM_CD , SZM0IA ia WHERE ys.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ys.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND ys.TR_CD <> 'G33' AND ys.CORP_GR = ia.CORP_GR AND ys.FUND_CD = ia.FUND_CD ORDER BY ya.JASAN_GB ASC , ys.GYULJE_YMD ASC , ys.CURRENCY ASC , ys.TR_YMD ASC , ys.TR_CD ASC , ys.FUND_CD ASC , ys.JM_CD ASC
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SYT0YS t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} ORDER BY ymd
SELECT t1.JM_CD FROM SYM0YA t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.CURRENCY = #{currency} AND t1.GYULJE_JM = 'Y' AND t1.JASAN_GB = '5' AND ROWNUM = 1
